# v0.72 implementation slices

Plan status: published nine-slice decomposition; nine child issues and native relationships confirmed by readback.
Approval: user's 2026-09-25 "$slice-contract issue 132 into 9 then" after review of the nine outcomes and dependency order.
Authorized writes: nine child issues in this repository, enhancement labels, native parent/blocker links, and this planning index. No contract, product code, PR, or sign-off change is authorized by this publication.

## Parent identity

- Source: [issue #132](https://github.com/trickle-labs/rockstream/issues/132); source body SHA-256 `809dd163221bc133ab5e71016d23df3bd9af11a3e5c51bb13bd` at publication.
- Source spec: [v0.72 plan](https://github.com/trickle-labs/rockstream/blob/6442838183ffd913b6a24860072575aacaa9c96a/docs/implementation-plans/v0.72.md), commit `6442838183ffd913b6a24860072575aacaa9c96a`, SHA-256 `66af6e6c735cb71550a40b54bec974c75db81dadd5462f5fd4a4dcf01ba9a1fb`.
- Canonical parent contract: [docs/acceptance-contracts/132.md](https://github.com/trickle-labs/rockstream/blob/7a73050dbb28fdf61584d052b9521b2e7dce9835/docs/acceptance-contracts/132.md) revision **v2**, SHA-256 `cc91b392f193e771e38336c7da3c62480ef7337083ce1a5c301f576096335734`.
- Frozen local profile: [profile-v072.toml](https://github.com/trickle-labs/rockstream/blob/7a73050dbb28fdf61584d052b9521b2e7dce9835/benchmarks/r1-local/profile-v072.toml) revision 1, SHA-256 `d5cf97b3d0a181cddd78dbf811e22224c4767bd1948143b45beb38390464719a`. These values are planning decisions, not measured capacity.
- Qualified references in this plan use `trickle-labs/rockstream#132 v2:Rn`. Child IDs are independent of parent IDs.

## Tickets

| Slice | Observable outcome | Parent contribution | Ticket |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| S1 | Enforce the workload resource envelope | R2-R6 | [#133](https://github.com/trickle-labs/rockstream/issues/133) |
| S2 | Schedule fairly with durable adaptive epochs | R7-R10; commit-resource portion of R6 | [#134](https://github.com/trickle-labs/rockstream/issues/134) |
| S3 | Serve bounded authorized interactive queries | R23-R26, R29; read-token portion of R27; query-resource portion of R6 | [#135](https://github.com/trickle-labs/rockstream/issues/135) |
| S4 | Stream bounded committed subscriptions | stream portion of R27; R28; subscription-resource portion of R6 | [#136](https://github.com/trickle-labs/rockstream/issues/136) |
| S5 | Apply workload changes by effective revision | R30-R31 | [#137](https://github.com/trickle-labs/rockstream/issues/137) |
| S6 | Measure eight canonical workloads with real process evidence | R1, R11; validator portion of R12; raw-sample portions of R19-R20 | [#138](https://github.com/trickle-labs/rockstream/issues/138) |
| S7 | Qualify scale and mixed-read capacity comparisons | R13-R16; comparison cells of R12; raw samples for R19-R20 | [#139](https://github.com/trickle-labs/rockstream/issues/139) |
| S8 | Qualify large-state recovery and sustained overload | R17-R18; fault cells of R12; raw samples for R19-R20 | [#140](https://github.com/trickle-labs/rockstream/issues/140) |
| S9 | Publish reproducible capacity and v0.72 sign-off | final R12, R19-R22, R32; assembled R6 check | [#141](https://github.com/trickle-labs/rockstream/issues/141) |

## Publication readback

All nine child titles and bodies match the submitted text byte for byte. Each has the `enhancement` label, native parent #132, and the planned native blocked-by edges. No child has `ready-for-agent`; each needs its own child contract. The parent source and contract text were left unchanged.

## Parent coverage

| Parent obligation | Allocation and material boundary | Completion check location |
| --- | --- | --- |
| R1 | S6 checks frozen profile in every manifest; S9 checks comparisons | `v072_profile_freeze` |
| R2 | S1 accounts for seven v0.72 classes and earlier storage allocations once per owner | `v072_memory_ownership` |
| R3 | S1 releases reservations on success, error, cancellation, shard removal, and restart; reconciles RSS | `v072_memory_lifecycle` |
| R4 | S1 throttles or adapts source and exchange producers at soft pressure | `v072_soft_pressure` |
| R5 | S1 rejects or truthfully degrades before hard allocation and rolls back failed reservations | `v072_hard_pressure` |
| R6 | S1 owns the complete limit/fill/overflow inventory; S2 owns commit resources, S3 query resources, S4 subscription resources | `v072_bounded_resources; parent proof` |
| R7 | S2 schedules by priority, pressure, freshness, and parallelism with fair read/control capacity | `v072_fair_schedule` |
| R8 | S2 preserves one ordered shard owner, dependency order, and capacity release after failure | `v072_ordered_failover` |
| R9 | S2 adapts bounded epochs from all four signals and rejects inconsistent bounds | `v072_epoch_adaptation` |
| R10 | S2 preserves durable ordered epochs, retries, and restart acknowledgements | `v072_durable_epochs` |
| R11 | S6 runs eight release-process workloads with complete independent results | `v072_eight_workloads` |
| R12 | S6 provides fail-closed matrix validation; S7 supplies comparison cells; S8 supplies fault cells; S9 checks full applicability | `v072_matrix_completeness` |
| R13 | S7 checks one-key writes and separate lookup cost at 1K, 100K, 10M | `v072_one_key_scale` |
| R14 | S7 checks one versus twenty views under identical load and durability | `v072_shared_views` |
| R15 | S7 checks 1, 2, 4, 8 active workers and host ceilings at fixed freshness | `v072_worker_scale` |
| R16 | S7 checks separate read and correct-result freshness targets under mixed load | `v072_mixed_reads` |
| R17 | S8 checks beyond-RAM eviction, compaction, migration, restart, full results, and bounds | `v072_large_state` |
| R18 | S8 checks bounded sustained overload and exact recovery under specified faults | `v072_overload_soak` |
| R19 | S6-S8 retain raw metrics; S9 publishes every required field, distribution, and unit | `v072_report_fields` |
| R20 | S6-S8 retain run identities and raw samples; S9 validates reproducibility and rejects invalid evidence | `v072_evidence_validation` |
| R21 | S9 computes itemized cost per million committed changes and scopes cloud claims | `v072_cost_report` |
| R22 | S9 checks frozen noise/regression budgets and explicit approved breaches | `v072_regression_gate` |
| R23 | S3 validates and explains through the production binder without mutation | `v072_validation` |
| R24 | S3 allows only authorized single-statement read-only interactive work | `v072_interactive_authority` |
| R25 | S3 enforces all producer query budgets before or during work | `v072_interactive_budgets` |
| R26 | S3 binds handles and releases upstream work on every terminal path | `v072_query_cleanup` |
| R27 | S3 supplies actual materialized-view read token; S4 streams complete ordered committed frames | `v072_subscription_epochs` |
| R28 | S4 bounds snapshots, epochs, buffers, streams, and slow clients with resnapshot behavior | `v072_subscription_bounds` |
| R29 | S3 supplies authorized bounded typed result pages and honest completion metadata | `v072_export_source` |
| R30 | S5 applies revision-conditioned edits and rejects conflicts/unsafe reductions | `v072_workload_conflict` |
| R31 | S5 propagates accepted revisions and reports requested versus effective owner state | `v072_workload_propagation` |
| R32 | S9 documents behavior and links release-process evidence for V072-01 through V072-13 | `check-exit-criteria.sh and evidence-link review` |

The source issue's negative promises also apply: no unbounded admission or silent result loss; no synthetic capacity claim; read, durable commit, and correct-result freshness remain separate; local measurements support local claims only. The v0.73.1 console API, CSV/download, unrestricted export, new workloads, and unmeasured cloud claims are excluded. S3 owns bounded producer pages, while the later console owns CSV and download.

## Dependencies and readiness

- S1 precedes S2 and S3 because they consume reliable resource accounting/admission.
- S1 and S2 precede S5 so effective workload revisions can change actual enforcement.
- S2 and S3 precede S4 so committed epoch frames and the read token are available.
- S6 has no child work blocker; runner development can proceed in parallel. Its final capacity runs require the integrated S1/S2 behavior.
- S6 precedes S7 and S8 because they consume its real-process manifests and result oracle. S8 also needs S1, S2, and S3 for its final overload run.
- S1 through S8 precede S9's complete report and sign-off. Shared files alone do not create other blockers.
- Before dependent qualification, confirm the linked release-process outcomes in the v0.71, v0.61.1, v0.61.2, v0.62.1, v0.65.1, v0.67.1, v0.68, v0.69, and v0.70 sign-offs. A checked box or closed issue alone is insufficient.
- Every child may proceed to `/plan-acceptance` using this index and the immutable v2 parent. Implementation needs its child contract and confirmed prerequisites. No child is labeled `ready-for-agent` at creation.

## Parent completion

S9 owns real report, documentation, matrix assembly, and sign-off work. Parent-level review and `/prove` then evaluate every R1-R32 obligation, all V072-01 through V072-13 source criteria, inherited invariants, and interactions on one exact integrated candidate. Historical child proofs cannot be combined into a parent verdict. Merge readiness remains separate.

Unresolved decisions: none. No shared-branch or non-green exception is planned.
